The '''''Crushed Courier''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] decommissioned prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its wreck was abandoned in [[Scrapheap Point]], a ship junkyard located on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].<ref name="BtR">''[[Beyond the Rim]]''</ref>
